mkv_subtitles.json contains deterministic EBML fixtures originally generated by
openlist-enhancer's MKV tests. These fixtures are independently checked in here;
the native player tests consume them directly without a plugin checkout or tools.
Coverage includes
ASS style/ReadOrder, UTF-8, 5 GiB virtual offsets, unknown Segment/Cluster sizes,
subtitle-only indexed reads, codecs and malformed/missing indexing. The sparse
fixture stores only metadata and simulates the large zero-filled gap in tests.
